verdict.rationale: Reflect's site describes local Markdown files with 'your choice of sync' via iCloud Drive or Git, so users can pick the storage backend for their notes. That is only indirect control over where data lives. No region selection or data-residency guarantees are documented, and other docs describe a server-hosted, end-to-end-encrypted service, so it is unclear which model applies. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection, documented data-center locations or residency commitments, independent corroboration.
